paragraphs.text: And he ended up in Duluth?

paragraphs.speaker: Grandma
paragraphs.text: He ended up on the ore boats. Loading iron ore at the docks in Duluth. That's where the work was.

paragraphs.speaker: Grandma
paragraphs.text: When I was little, maybe seven or eight, I'd walk my dad's lunch down to the ore dock. A tin pail. And the dock was so tall you had to tip your head all the way…
